content_sections.heading: PGI Sangrur Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The PGI Satellite Centre, Sangrur, Punjab, has 23 vacancies , comprising 21 Senior Resident and two Senior Medical Officer posts. Posting Clarification: Candidates selected for PGI Satellite Centre, Sangrur, will be appointed there. They cannot claim a posting at PGIMER Chandigarh on the basis of selection for Sangrur vacancies.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications differ according to the selected specialty and post. Applicants must possess the prescribed qualification and registration certificates. Senior Resident applicants must possess: A recognized medical qualification prescribed under the applicable medical education requirements. Registration with the Central or State Medical Council. An MD/MS degree or equivalent postgraduate qualification in the concerned specialty. For Senior Resident posts under the Oral Health Science Centre, candidates must possess a recognized dental qualification, registration with the Central or State Dental Council and an MDS degree in the relevant specialty . The notified dental specialties include Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics, Periodontics and Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery. Demonstrator posts have separate medical and non-medical eligibility routes. The essential qualifications depend on the department and appointment level. Candidates must obtain and provide a valid qualifying degree or pass certificate by 31 December 2026 . Candidates appearing in their final qualifying examination in December 2026 may apply, provided they obtain the qualification and submit the pass certificate before the prescribed deadline. Important: Candidates whose qualifying examination result is declared after 31 December 2026, or who cannot provide the required pass certificate by that date, will not be eligible.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for the advertised posts is 45 years as of the online application closing date, with relaxation for eligible categories. Age Relaxation Conditions: Reserved-category candidates applying against unreserved vacancies cannot claim reserved-category age relaxation. The maximum age limit for eligible PwBD applicants after applicable relaxation must not exceed 56 years.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive the pay level applicable to their post under the Central Government pay matrix. NPA refers to Non-Practising Allowance, applicable to the specified medical positions. Other admissible allowances will be governed by the institute's applicable service rules.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Application fees must be paid online through the recruitment application portal using Debit Card, Credit Card or Net Banking. The institute advises applicants to avoid UPI payments.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a Computer Based Test carrying 75 marks and a Departmental Interview and Assessment carrying 25 marks. Computer Based Test on 5 December 2026. Department-wise and category-wise shortlisting based on CBT marks. Scrutiny of shortlisted candidates' applications and uploaded documents. Publication of the eligibility notice. Document verification. Departmental Interview and Assessment. Final merit preparation using CBT and departmental assessment marks. Shortlisting Ratio: Candidates will normally be shortlisted in a ratio of 1:3 against the advertised department-wise and category-wise vacancies. Final Merit: Only candidates who separately qualify in both the CBT and Departmental Interview and Assessment will be considered for final selection. Final merit will be based on the combined score out of 100 marks.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER CBT Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: These qualifying standards apply separately to the CBT and the Departmental Interview and Assessment.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER CBT Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The CBT syllabus will be based on the prescribed educational qualifications, professional courses and relevant experience requirements for the selected post and specialty. Questions may cover subjects studied during the professional or postgraduate qualification required for the relevant department. The detailed guidelines do not prescribe a common chapter-wise syllabus for every post.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 Exam Centres
content_sections.text: The Computer Based Test is expected to be conducted in four cities. Applicants must select their preferred examination city while completing the online application. Examination centres are allotted on a first-come, first-served basis, subject to availability and administrative requirements. Once allotted, the examination city cannot be changed at the candidate's request.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 Department and Institute Preference
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply for the relevant post in one department only . Where the same post and department are available at PGIMER Chandigarh and PGI Satellite Centre Sangrur, candidates may indicate preferences for one or both institutes while completing the online form. Important: Candidates who do not indicate a preference for an institute will not be considered for the concerned institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PGIMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Application Warning: The institute states that candidates cannot change their registration or application entries after submission. Incorrect or incomplete entries may lead to rejection without reconsideration.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for PGIMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Matriculation / 10th certificate and marksheet. 10+2 certificate and marksheet. MBBS, BDS or other prescribed undergraduate qualification certificates. Relevant MD/MS, MDS, MA, MSc, MPH, MHA or PhD certificates, as applicable. Relevant experience certificates. Medical Council or Dental Council registration certificate, where applicable. SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD certificates, where applicable. No Objection Certificate for candidates serving in Government, Semi-Government or Autonomous Bodies, where applicable. Other prescribed eligibility and reservation documents. Certificate Requirement: Candidates claiming OBC or EWS reservation must satisfy the certificate issuing-date requirements specified in the notification. The guidelines specify certificates issued from 1 April 2026 to 13 November 2026 for the applicable OBC Non-Creamy Layer and EWS claims.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 Tenure and Posting
content_sections.text: The advertised positions are tenure appointments for a maximum period of three years. Selected candidates will serve at PGIMER Chandigarh or PGI Satellite Centre Sangrur according to the relevant vacancy, eligibility and institute preference. The vacancies are provisional and may change. The institute may also fill qualifying vacancies arising during the notified period from the waiting list as permitted by the guidelines.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research, Chandigarh (PGIMER) to fill various tenure posts including Senior Residents and Senior Medical Officers.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced in PGIMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 162 vacancies have been announced for various posts such as Senior Residents, Senior Medical Officers, and Junior/Senior Demonstrators across different departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for PGIMER Posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 13 November 2026. Candidates are advised to complete their registration well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to PGIMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for applicants is upto 45 years. Age relaxations are provided for reserved categories like SC, ST, OBC, and PwBD as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to the General, OBC, and EWS categories are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1500/- plus applicable transaction charges.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a postgraduate degree such as an MD or MS in the relevant specialty along with valid registration with the Central or State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Computer Based Test (CBT) carrying 75 marks followed by scrutiny of documents and a departmental interview and assessment carrying 25 marks.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any negative marking in the Computer Based Test?
faq.answer: Yes, there is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each incorrect answer attempted by candidates in the Computer Based Test.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for Senior Residents at PGIMER?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for Senior Resident posts will be placed in Level-11 of the Pay Matrix with a minimum basic pay of Rs. 67,700/- plus Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA).

faq.question: Q10. How can eligible candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official PGIMER website at pgimer.edu.in, navigating to the recruitment section, filling out the application form, and paying the fee.
